title: Kernel-check full finite wire records and the two field orders
description: Check unconditional arbitrary-suffix decoding for every 32-bit VInt and fixed header, both endian directions and both field orders. Prove finite sequence composition, one-record progress and valid Java cursor bounds. Bind the theorem to the original release identities and reject a false all-input byte-order identity.
expected: Every named claim elaborates with printed axioms and the false mixed-endian identity is rejected.
